title: automation: HA/DR runbooks-as-code + multi-AZ restore drills (Helm/Terraform)
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: improve Private deployment HA/DR readiness by encoding runbooks as code, adding deterministic restore drills for multi-AZ clusters, and wiring Terraform + Helm automation so restore and failover drills can be executed end-to-end in CI. This PR packages three related pieces: 1) a runbooks-as-code DSL (YAML-based) for describing drill steps and assertions; 2) Helm/values changes and new charts hooks to support graceful failover and restore; 3) Terraform module updates and example task definitions for automated drills. Summary of changes (one-line): add runbooks-as-code for HA/DR, multi-AZ restore drill playbooks, Terraform automation tasks, Helm hooks and chart templates, and CI job to run nightly restore drills in a sandbox. What changed (high level): - runbooks/ha-dr/: new directory with YAML-based runbook definitions and test harness for executing drills programmatically. Runbooks include pre-checks, failover steps, restore steps, traffic-shift across AZs, KV cache warmup, and post-validation checks against a golden prompt set. - terraform/modules/ha-dr/ : new module that provisions sandboxed multi-AZ networking, test cluster config, and IAM roles for drill runner. - helm/charts/private-installer/: templates for a new 'drill-runner' Kubernetes Job and service accounts, and hooks for pre-stop drain + post-start warmup. - tooling/upgrade-rollback/: scripts to perform controlled upgrade + rollback with checkpointing so a restore drill can be replayed. - ci/ha-dr-drill.yml: new GH Actions workflow that runs the runbook in an isolated sandbox nightly and reports results to Slack and Sentry. Checklist: - [x] Runbook DSL + interpreter implemented - [x] Helm chart templates and hooks added - [x] Terraform module and examples added - [x] CI workflow + secrets gating added - [x] Docs + runbook examples added to docs site How to test locally: 1) Provision sandbox: cd terraform/examples/ha-dr-sandbox && terraform apply -auto-approve 2) Deploy charts: helm upgrade --install private-installer helm/charts/private-installer -f helm/charts/private-installer/values-ha.yaml --namespace redwood-test 3) Run drill: ./tools/drill-runner/bin/run --runbook runbooks/ha-dr/multi-az-restore.yaml --kubeconfig $KUBECONFIG Backward compatibility: all changes are additive. The Helm hooks are optional and controlled via values.enableDrillHooks (default: false). Terraform modules are opt-in examples and do not change existing modules. Notes on safety: the runbook interpreter enforces a "dry-run" mode and requires an explicit --confirm flag to run destructive steps. The CI job runs in a sandboxed account with least-privilege IAM roles and limited quotas to prevent accidental production impact. References: Linear: ENG-4821 (runbooks-as-code), ENG-4912 (drill automation). Related PRs: pr-32715, pr-42186 (previous HA/DR automation iterations).
